A hypothetical long strangle pairs an out-of-the-money put with an out-of-the-money call to capture a larger swing either way.

October 30 expiration:
• Buy $130 put at $1.40
• Buy $160 call at $1.08
• Total cost / maximum loss: $248

At expiration, the combined position profits below $127.52 or above $162.48. Between $130 and $160, both options expire worthless.
